suggestions.title: Validate attribution before scaling promotion
suggestions.known: The supplied tracking ID is present in direct product links. No Associates destination/report validation is available here.
suggestions.missing: An enrolled-workflow check and authorized tracking report for one link per product.

options.label: Validate five pilot links
options.detail: Recommended. Confirm the exact intended ASIN, generate/check its Special Link in the enrolled workflow and inspect the authorized report before wider distribution.

options.label: Keep the research edit only
options.detail: Do not scale campaigns while account-level attribution remains unresolved.

suggestions.effort: Estimate: one account-level validation pass, then report availability; not an automated guarantee.
suggestions.risk: A syntactically tagged URL is not proof that an account is eligible or that an order was attributed.

suggestions.title: Connect the counter to infrastructure you control
suggestions.known: The collector and browser client are implemented and tested. GitHub Pages cannot run a server.
suggestions.missing: An owner-controlled HTTPS host/reverse proxy, its logging settings and privacy review.

options.label: Self-host behind the same origin
options.detail: Recommended. Run the supplied service, keep the aggregate database private, disable access logs and test real persistence before activation.

options.label: Wait without collecting
options.detail: Keep the explicit disabled configuration. Do not collect browser-local queues or pretend orders are measured.

suggestions.effort: Estimate: deployment and end-to-end verification; recurring hosting responsibility.
suggestions.risk: Raw events can include bots. They cannot establish unique humans, eligible Sessions or purchases.

suggestions.title: Let measured questions choose the next guide
suggestions.known: Four question-led guides form the current starting cluster. No search-query export is available.
suggestions.missing: A verified URL-prefix property and dated query/page performance export.

options.label: Review actual query gaps weekly
options.detail: Recommended. Refresh a useful existing answer before proposing another near-duplicate page.

options.label: Hold new topics until data arrives
options.detail: Maintain the existing guides and source checks without inventing trend or search-volume claims.

suggestions.effort: Estimate: one weekly editorial review after access and sufficient observations exist.
suggestions.risk: A sitemap helps discovery; it does not guarantee indexing, ranking or sales.

suggestions.title: Add real authorship and original product photography
suggestions.known: Current bylines name an organization, not a fictional reviewer. The food hero is labelled AI-generated; diagrams are not product photographs.
suggestions.missing: A consenting accountable editor, documented experience and licensed or original product images.

options.label: Commission a documented hands-on review
options.detail: Recommended when feasible. Record who used which model, the method, limits and image rights before changing any review claims.

options.label: Remain explicitly research-based
options.detail: Retain the current organization byline, format illustrations and no hands-on verdicts.

suggestions.effort: Estimate: depends on product access, editor availability and rights clearance; no invented budget.
suggestions.risk: Do not imply firsthand testing or reproduce marketplace media without a permitted route.

suggestions.title: Keep RSS now; consider email only with a real service
suggestions.known: The existing RSS endpoint and the new root feed contain real guide links. No email subscription backend is connected.
suggestions.missing: An approved provider, consent/retention plan and tested unsubscribe workflow before an email form can be offered.

options.label: Use the working RSS feed
options.detail: Recommended for now. No email address, account or pretend success message is needed.

options.label: Review an opt-in email service
options.detail: Only after privacy, deliverability and unsubscribe behavior have been approved and tested.

suggestions.effort: RSS has no signup workflow. Email introduces recurring operational and privacy work.
suggestions.risk: Never display a subscription form that silently discards addresses or claims an unconfigured signup succeeded.

suggestions.title: Hold AI publishing behind an evidence gate
suggestions.known: Reproducible builds, source-linked tables and policy tests are automated. No profitable-niche, demand or revenue score has been established.
suggestions.missing: Authorized catalog/report data and a recorded editorial decision for each new factual or commercial claim.

options.label: Draft automatically, publish after checks
options.detail: Recommended. Require source coverage, blank unknowns, disclosure, sponsored links and an accountable editorial review.

options.label: Pause unattended drafting
options.detail: Prioritize source maintenance and measured reader questions instead of increasing the page count.

suggestions.effort: Estimate: review time grows with new claims, not just the number of generated words.
suggestions.risk: Bulk rewriting product listings is not original reporting and provides no traffic or revenue guarantee.

questions.question: Are the five observed listings the products you intended?
questions.known: Five supplied URLs and five observed Amazon destinations are recorded separately.
questions.missing: Intended ASIN, official listing URL, confirmation date and confirmation source for each submission.
questions.discover: Use the enrolled Associates workflow to confirm each exact model/variant and retain the official listing and dated confirmation. Do not copy an observation into an intent field.

questions.question: Does this site and tag belong to an eligible enrolled account?
questions.known: The brief supplies shopnow047c-20. That string is configured in product links.
questions.missing: Enrolled account/site eligibility, marketplace confirmation and a first-party attribution report.
questions.discover: Review the account’s site settings and one pilot link per product, then retain the authorized dated tracking export. No self-purchases or artificial clicks.

questions.question: Where can the production collector actually run?
questions.known: The tested service can run on an owner-controlled host. Pages itself is static.
questions.missing: A provisioned HTTPS same-origin route, host responsibility, log controls and privacy/legal review.
questions.discover: Deploy behind a controlled reverse proxy, exercise the health/POST contract using an isolated test database, verify private storage and retention, then activate the production client.

questions.question: Which searches bring qualified readers here?
questions.known: No authorized Search Console query export is available. Topic titles are editorial hypotheses, not trends.
questions.missing: A verified property and a dated performance export with query/page impressions and clicks.
questions.discover: Verify the site property with its owner’s Google account and import a personal-data-reviewed first-party export. Compare like periods; do not equate impressions with visits.

questions.question: Who is the primary buyer, and in which marketplace?
questions.known: The observed destinations are on Amazon.com. A visitor’s location does not establish the intended market.
questions.missing: Declared audience, marketplace, budget context and household/cooking needs.
questions.discover: Review authorized aggregate location/query reports when available. Record the audience choice explicitly before localizing links or making budget/value recommendations.

questions.question: Who can provide accountable firsthand review and imagery?
questions.known: This edit is AI-assisted source research. No product-use experience or individual reviewer credentials are claimed.
questions.missing: A real editor’s consent/credentials, test records for the exact variants and image permissions.
questions.discover: Obtain product access and original test/photo records or documented media rights. Preserve the research-only label until that evidence exists.

questions.question: Which specifications still need manufacturer clarification?
questions.known: Emeril’s official sections disagree on presets; Chefman’s 8 Qt manufacturer page and Amazon title disagree on maximum temperature.
questions.missing: Current exact-variant manual or written manufacturer clarification that resolves each conflict.
questions.discover: Match the model and revision to its manual or manufacturer support response. Keep each conflicting observation dated; do not choose the more marketable number.

cadence.status: Editorial operating plan, not a claim that a scheduled publisher is running
cadence.weekly: Every Monday: review authorized query/click reports, verify one existing guide’s sources, then propose at most one substantive update or new question.
cadence.publish_gate: Publish only after sources, intent/attribution gates where relevant, disclosure, sponsored links, editorial review and the full build pass. Otherwise hold; do not fill the slot with generated copy.
cadence.monthly: Monthly: review source drift, broken links, duplicate topics and authorized reported outcomes. Re-check the hosting/privacy controls before enabling new collection.
cadence.topic_rule: No topic is labelled trending, high-converting or profitable without dated authorized data. Seasonal packaging is editorial context, not demand evidence.
